subject: literacy
concept: Recognizing initial consonant blends (st, bl, dr, etc.) as two distinct sounds said quickly together
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading explicit phonics sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student slides two separate letter tiles together quickly while saying both sounds in the blend
exercise.pictorial: Student circles the blend within a set of pictured words
exercise.abstract: Student identifies the blend at the start of a spoken word

misconception_flags: confuses a blend (two distinct sounds) with a digraph (one blended sound)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
